description: The network module contains commands and events that relate to network requests.

types.description: Whether network requests use resource caches as usual, or bypass them.

commands.name: setCacheBehavior
commands.description: Makes network requests bypass resource caches, or use them as usual, in the given top-level browsing contexts, or everywhere.

parameters.name: contexts
parameters.description: Top-level browsing contexts to set the cache behavior for.
